environment.aggregation: Median of run medians and their range; p95/p99 are medians of per-run percentiles, not pooled tails.
environment.order: Rotate incremental size order; alternate reuse baseline/candidate process order and --retained-first every round.
environment.order_balance: Odd repeat counts leave one extra initial-order run; even counts balance the two orders exactly.
environment.scope: CPU wall time. No X11 transfer, GPU, vsync, input-to-display latency or power measurement. Payload bytes are calculated.
environment.validity: All candidate reuse frames must match their full control. Both versions must share full-control sequence digests. Invalid baseline retained timings are kept only in raw reports.

metadata.scope: One shared UI build per input frame, excluding the scenario's preceding input/state mutation. Full/incremental draw order changes every two frames to decouple it from alternating scene states. Bytewise framebuffer equality and sequence hashing run after every frame outside timing. Pixel payload is a calculated byte count, not timed X11 transport.

baseline.scope: CPU Context.begin + public Frame.reuse scene + Frame.end; no rasterization or presentation
baseline.percentiles: nearest rank; individual frame wall-clock samples in nanoseconds
baseline.mixed_updates: signal changes, keyboard activation, repeating timer, ancestor clip/position/opacity, scale and moved row indices
baseline.run_order: Cases alternate full/retained order; pass --retained-first on alternating process runs to reverse every case
baseline.comparison_rule: Compare timings only when every frame's output hash, dimensions and cumulative update counters match. Per-frame checks and step-tagged sequence digests are outside timing; hashes are regression evidence, not mathematical equivalence proof.

candidate.scope: CPU Context.begin + public Frame.reuse scene + Frame.end; no rasterization or presentation
candidate.percentiles: nearest rank; individual frame wall-clock samples in nanoseconds
candidate.mixed_updates: signal changes, keyboard activation, repeating timer, ancestor clip/position/opacity, scale and moved row indices
candidate.run_order: Cases alternate full/retained order; pass --retained-first on alternating process runs to reverse every case
candidate.comparison_rule: Compare timings only when every frame's output hash, dimensions and cumulative update counters match. Per-frame checks and step-tagged sequence digests are outside timing; hashes are regression evidence, not mathematical equivalence proof.

retained.invalid_reason: Retained work differs from its full control. Timings remain in the raw JSON and are excluded from summary timing comparisons.
